rationale: Build on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline with a compact structural variant from the locally promising anchor family. Add a learned per-tail-block dual-anchor blend between the pre-tail entry state and the decoder-output anchor, and keep the new control tensor on the float-preserved export path. This spends a run on a real recurrence-path change instead of another scalar sweep or curriculum replay.
title: Dual-Anchor Reverse Tail Carry
